cast.name: 维克多·梅特莱特 Victor Meutelet

introduction: Nathan, in his twenties and amidst his medical studies, feelsdisconnected from his life. Seeking clarity about his uncertainfuture, he decides to embark on a solo vacation to Corsica.Amidst the blazing summer sun, the introverted young man encounters Léana and Felix, with whom he shares a modestroom in a youth hostel. The duo warmly embraces him as ifthey were old friends, which unsettles Nathan. Initially distant,he gradually forms an unexpected bond with this contrastingpair, ultimately leading to a profound transformation.
